services.desc: The Surf City Tour includes the Newport Beach Tour and the following: Huntington State Beach, Huntington Beach, Bolsa Chica Ecological Reserve, Hyatt & Hilton Resorts, and the famous Huntington Beach Pier. Huntington Beach is known as “Surf City” and is home to the US Open of Surfing. Catch the waves from above! This twenty-minute airtime (lift to land), thirty-mile tour takes off from the airport and heads north along Newport Beach up to Huntington Beach before returning to the airport. Want the helicopter all to yourself and a guest at a great price? Select private tour for 2 for $750. Cancelation A MINIMUM of 72 hours (not including date of flight) rescheduling/ cancellation notice
